title: Customer Service Executive
company: Wallace Hind Selection LTD - Agency - Permanent
salary_text: £26000 per year (22 Days Holiday + Pension + Bonus + Wellbeing)
description: We're looking for a Customer Service Executive to join a growing industrial supplies business based in Bidford-on-Avon. If you're organised, confident communicating with customers and have an interest in e-commerce, this could be the ideal role for you. You'll be joining a friendly, supportive team, helping to manage online orders and deliver a great customer experience. BASIC SALARY: Up to £26,000 BENEFITS: 22 Days Annual Leave (increasing with service) Pension Annual Performance Bonus Wellbeing Package LOCATION: Office-based in Bidford-on-Avon. COMMUTABLE LOCATIONS: Stratford-upon-Avon, Redditch, Evesham, Worcester JOB DESCRIPTION: Customer Service Executive, Customer Service Administrator, E-Commerce Assistant Working closely with our E-Commerce Team Leader, as our Customer Service Executive, you'll support the day-to-day running of our online sales operation, ensuring orders are processed efficiently, customers are kept informed and any queries are dealt with promptly. You will: Process customer orders received through our online sales channels. Monitor orders through to dispatch and coordinate with couriers to resolve delivery queries. Respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email. Update and maintain information using Excel and internal systems. Prepare and manage documentation, including invoices and certificates of analysis. PERSON SPECIFICATION: Customer Service Executive, Customer Service Administrator, E-Commerce Assistant You'll be organised, enthusiastic and comfortable working in a busy environment. You'll have a keen eye for detail, enjoy helping customers and be confident juggling different tasks throughout the day. Ideally, you'll have: Previous experience in customer service, administration or another customer-facing role. An interest in online selling or e-commerce platforms such as eBay, Shopify or Vinted, whether professionally or personally. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook. Strong communication skills and a practical approach to problem-solving. THE COMPANY: We are an established UK distributor of specialist adhesives, sealants, tapes and coatings, supplying customers across the manufacturing, automotive and electronics industries. Alongside our traditional distribution business, we're continuing to develop our online sales channels, including Shopify and eBay, as part of our wider growth plans. PROSPECTS: Whether you're a recent graduate, have some customer service experience or are looking to develop a career in e-commerce, we'll provide the training and support you need. With continued business growth through acquisitions and an expanding online operation, there will be opportunities to develop your skills and progress within the business. INTERESTED? Please click apply. You will receive an acknowledgement of your application. Wallace Hind Selection, alongside our client embrace diversity, champion equality, and foster inclusion to create a work environment where everyone belongs and thrives. Please Note: Wallace Hind Selection have been chosen as the retained recruitment partner of our client and therefore any direct applications to our client from candidates or agencies will be forwarded on to us direct. REF: SM18723, Wallace Hind Selection

title: Customer Service Agent
description: Customer Support Advisor - 12 Month FTC We're recruiting on behalf of our client for a Customer Support Advisor to join their busy and friendly customer service team in Coventry. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys helping customers, solving problems, and delivering outstanding service. Salary for this position will be starting at 29,000 working on a rota basis in a busy and friendly team. There is the requirement to be flexible, the company phone lines are open 7 days a week. Weekday shifts are between 7am and 7pm with weekends being typically 7am till 3pm which, once trained, are worked from home. The company offers fantastic benefits including a hybrid working model. The Role As a Customer Support Advisor, you'll be the first point of contact for customers, providing support with delivery and service enquiries. You'll play a key role in ensuring every customer receives a professional, efficient, and positive experience. Key Responsibilities - Handle customer enquiries in a courteous, friendly, and professional manner. - Respond to enquiries relating to deliveries and services. - Accurately log and categorise customer interactions using internal systems. - Complete customer verification and security checks. - Triage customer queries and escalate complex issues to the Customer Support Specialist team where appropriate. - Take ownership of customer queries through to resolution. - Work towards individual and team KPI targets. - Attend team meetings and training sessions, contributing positively to the team. - Promote and demonstrate the company's core values. - Be flexible and support the wider team with additional tasks as required by management. Person Specification We're looking for someone who has: - Proven experience in a customer support or customer service role, or experience as a Client Service Representative. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. - A customer-focused approach with the ability to adapt your communication style to suit different customers. - Strong organisational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritise workloads, and manage time effectively. - Excellent attention to detail. - Good computer literacy, including experience using Microsoft Office applications. - A professional, flexible, driven, and positive attitude. - The ability to remain organised and self-disciplined while working under pressure. - A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively as part of a team. What's on Offer - Full training provided. - Friendly and supportive working environment. - Opportunity to develop your customer service skills within a growing business. If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer service and are looking for your next opportunity in Coventry, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to join a business that puts customer experience at the heart of everything it does.

title: Customer Service Coordinator
description: Customer Service Coordinator Osprey Engineering Solutions are currently hiring on behalf of a leading supplier of pneumatic and automation components such as pneumatic cylinders, valves, fittings, air preparation units, electric actuation and fluid control products to OEMs, maintenance teams, end users and a UK-wide network of authorised distributors. They are looking for a Customer Service Coordinator to join their growing team. The role As Customer Service Coordinator you will be the first point of contact for customers and distributors. You will process orders, quotations and enquiries accurately, keep customers informed on stock and delivery, and work closely with our warehouse, workshop, technical and sales teams to make sure every order arrives on time and right first time. This is a busy, varied role suited to someone who is organised, enjoys solving problems and takes pride in looking after customers. Key responsibilities - Receive and process customer and distributor orders received by phone, email, EDI and web, entering them accurately onto the ERP system. - Check stock availability, pricing and lead times, and confirm orders to customers promptly. - Handle incoming calls and emails professionally, resolving queries at first contact wherever possible. - Prepare quotations and follow them up in line with sales team priorities. - Use product catalogues and part numbers to identify the right components, referring technical questions to the technical support team. - Build strong working relationships with key accounts and our authorised distributor network. - Log and manage returns, credits, delivery issues and complaints through to resolution. - Liaise with carriers and couriers on shipments, including any export paperwork. - Keep customer records, pricing and account details up to date. Skills and experience Essential - Experience in customer service, sales order processing or sales support. - Confident, professional telephone manner and clear written communication. - Strong attention to detail with numbers, part codes and pricing. - Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Outlook and Excel. - Experience using an ERP or order processing system. - GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths at grade 4/C or above. Desirable - Experience in an industrial, engineering or technical distribution business. - Knowledge of pneumatics, automation or fluid power products. - Experience working with distributors or trade customers. - Familiarity with export documentation and international shipping.

title: Customer Care Advisor
description: Customer Care Advisor We are working exclusively with an extremely well-known, European leading organisation on the lookout for a Customer Care Advisor to join their team in Warwick. This is an incredible opportunity to join a great company within a fantastic team. You will be responsible for assisting customers with product queries, including identification, product codes & compatibility. You will also be responsible for an account base, processing orders and assisting with availability, pricing, and general enquiries. You will provide high quality technically competent advice to customers, providing a triage function to support customers through their warranty, quality, and spares requirements to provide a first pass resolution wherever possible. You will be able to identify where to escalate more complicated product and aftersales queries when the need arises. These customer enquiries will be received by phone, email, on-line and in future via online chat. Key Responsibilities: - To be the initial point of contact for queries coming into the Customer Care Team, with a particular focus on: Product related queries, fulfilling customer requests for brochures, datasheets and general product information, order queries, completing product registrations, checking customer records on the system, acting as a triage function, being proactive in using all company systems - To take full ownership of an account list, ensuring that: Orders are processed to a high degree of accuracy and in a timely manner, issues are identified and resolved, the customer is supported with delivery issues, orders are monitored orders, records are accurate - Maintain excellent communications with customers on query resolution, escalating issues as required to the Customer Care Team Leader - To be able to handle multiple queries at any given me via different platforms, such as telephone, ticket-based email system and SAP - To drive a customer focussed approach across all activities and ensure the Customer Support Team is a centre of excellence, maintaining outstanding customer service both internally and externally by putti 1ng the customer at the heart of everything you do - Working closely with both internal teams and external partners to ensure all investigations are dealt with quickly and efficiently - Drive and contribute to continuous improvement within the business KEY SKILLS - Good standard of general education i.e. GCS, O Level - Solid and demonstrable experience in customer facing roles - Previous experience of problem-solving methodologies - Prepared to learn new skills - SAP experience - Excellent IT knowledge (Excel, Work, Outlook, databases, CRM) - Ability to work independently or as part of a team - Customer Focused - Ability to communicate with a wide range of people, both internally and externally, both written and verbally - An obsession for delivering customer service excellence and enhancing the company brand image - Outgoing and confident - Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment - Good knowledge of Microsoft Office including Excel and Word By applying for this position, you authorise Auctoro Recruitment to hold your personal details on file for use in finding you a suitable position. Auctoro Recruitment will never transfer your information to a third party without your prior consent.

title: Customer Service Representative
description: Job title: Supply Chain - Customer Service Representative Location: Warwick Contract length: 6 months rolling contract (with long-term potential) Work Structure: Hybrid (2 days in the office) Randstad Sourceright, a leading provider of RPO & MSP Recruitment Services is currently recruiting for a Supply Chain - Customer Service Representative to join a World leader offering Products, Solutions and Services across the entire Mobility value chain on behalf of a well established manufacturing organisation to play a key role in supporting Manufacturing Operations. The Supply Chain Customer Service Representative serves as the key interface between international customers and internal operational functions, managing the end-to-end order lifecycle within the Aero Derivative Gas Turbine (AGT) product line. Key responsibilities include processing customer quotations, sales orders, and ERP transactions, alongside monitoring project milestones, investigating pricing structures, and ensuring strict compliance with operational customs and export control regulations. Acting as the primary point of contact, this role facilitates cross-departmental coordination across supply chain functions, leads customer-facing meetings, and resolves delivery issues under tight deadlines to maintain high service standards. Some of the duties will include but are not limited to: - Input and process customer quotations, sales orders, and associated documents into the company ERP system (SAP) within agreed target times. - Maintain accurate data entry and high attention to detail across all order records and customer files. - Act as the primary point of contact for global customers, communicating regular updates on order plans and progress. - Organize and chair customer meetings to review delivery timelines and maintain high customer service standards. - Resolve customer issues promptly or escalate critical problems within set company timescales. - Liaise with internal departments (procurement, logistics, operations, engineering) to ensure customer requirements are delivered on schedule. - Follow up on roadblocks across internal functions to avoid dispatch or manufacturing delays. - Apply and adhere to export control, customs compliance, and operational customs regulations for international shipments. - Monitor customer-specific trade rules, limitations, and regulatory requirements across global accounts. - Investigate underlying costs to help resolve customer pricing queries. - Prepare and update spreadsheets with cost and pricing data to support commercial decision-making. - Coordinate with line managers and system super users to identify training needs and maintain up-to-date knowledge. - Assist management with administrative duties and ad-hoc reporting as required. Essential Requirements: - Demonstrated working knowledge of the supply chain function, especially regarding customer interaction, quality standards, and overall business acumen. - Hands-on experience in order processing and customer service management. - Solid, clear understanding of operational customs controls, export controls, and customs compliance. - Familiarity with tracking and adhering to changing international regulations and specific customer-relationship trade limitations. - Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (particularly spreadsheet management in Excel for cost/pricing investigations). - Experience with ERP systems; hands-on capability in SAP is strongly desired. - High level of accuracy and keen attention to detail while working toward tight delivery deadlines. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a professional, well-organized approach. - Strong collaborative mindset with the ability to operate effectively within cross-functional teams and liaise with global customers. Desirable Requirements: - Direct hands-on experience using SAP is highly desirable for processing sales orders, quotations, and tracking transactions. - Degree qualification in a Supply Chain discipline is considered an advantage. - Background or familiarity within the energy sector, power generation, or industrial machinery (such as Aero Derivative Gas Turbines). - Previous experience managing global customer accounts and liaising with international cross-functional teams.
